first_breath.name: First Breath
first_breath.lore: Atop the cliff-temple, a thin figure breathes in time with the wind. "You wish to step on air? First — prove you can survive on it."
first_breath.completedFlavor: Reva nods slowly. "You moved when the wind moved. That is the first step." Wind Step is yours.

first_dawn.name: First Dawn
first_dawn.lore: In the Sanctuary's open courtyard, Iyra waits at dawn. "To walk the sun's path, you must first burn brightly enough to be seen by it."
first_dawn.completedFlavor: Iyra closes her eyes. "The sun has marked you." Sun Walk is yours.

tides_of_sanctuary.name: Tides of Sanctuary
tides_of_sanctuary.lore: By the Sanctuary's reflecting pool, Solen watches the water rise and fall. "Harmony is not the absence of force. It is force that knows when to yield."
tides_of_sanctuary.completedFlavor: Solen touches the pool. The ripples follow you out. Tide Veil is yours.

oath_of_iron.name: Oath of Iron
oath_of_iron.lore: Vance does not look up from the whetstone. "The Order does not teach. It tests. Bring me proof you can stand."
oath_of_iron.completedFlavor: Vance hands you the whetstone. "The Order recognizes you." Bone Crush is yours.

void_initiation.name: Void Initiation
void_initiation.lore: Kael speaks without moving his mouth. "The Rift gives. It also takes. Are you prepared to lose pieces of yourself?"
void_initiation.completedFlavor: Kael smiles — somewhere behind his face. "Now you can cut." Void Sever is yours.

broken_communion.name: Broken Communion
broken_communion.lore: "You've felt the corruption in your shards," Kael whispers. "Bring me four more bound by chain. Prove you can carry the noise."
broken_communion.completedFlavor: Kael nods. The shards in your vault hum more loudly now. You feel the Rift watching back.
